title: Unreserved Imag32 quads over reserved pairs make calls with stack arguments abort
summary: llvm-mos#594 (mlund, draft, head 7b80f7e18768) adds RL quads as super-registers of the RS pairs but does not reserve a quad whose pair is reserved. LLVM counts a register unit as reserved only when its root and all of its super-registers are reserved, so the stack pointer RS0 (covered by RL0) stops being reserved at the unit level. Any function that makes a call with stack arguments, such as a variadic call, then aborts in the register coalescer with "LLVM ERROR: Invalid global physical register" (a use of $rs0 without a def during live-range computation), in every MOS CPU mode including default mos6502 code. Reproduced with #594 applied to upstream 06bc967d2668 alone and in the #320 split. Fixed in the split by the commit after #594, which reserves a quad whenever either of its RS pairs is reserved.
attribution: Found while carrying llvm-mos#594 into the #320 series; reduction, repair, evidence and this record: Claude Code 2.1.285 t4-opus-high agent a7633adfeee82a4f5, model Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), high reasoning effort (agent definition); dispatched from session 310aee67-a99e-4b78-ba48-c560322fe80d (https://claude.ai/code/session_01Skyq488smgqkyyzHrcCX7F).
unknowns: #594 was not built on its own base 07baad39bea5; the defect is shown on 06bc967d2668, which differs from that base by #570, #571, #586, #605 and the #321 series (the upstream-only build u594 excludes #321).
#594 as posted still carries the defect; the fix is a separate commit in the #320 series, not part of #594.

prior_work.source_assessment: #594's getReservedRegs is unchanged from upstream (precomputed reserved set plus the frame pointer), so no RL quad is reserved; downstream and the reviewed split reserve a quad over a reserved pair (rule from aa5d0544).
prior_work.binary_assessment: Upstream base llc p-321-00 compiles variadic-call.ll; base + #594 (u594) and the series #594 commit abort with the signature; adding only the reservation rule (u594-resv) and the series fix commit compile it.
prior_work.decision: New canonical record: the abort appears only when RL is defined without the downstream reservation rule, which no earlier record or report covers.

resolution.change: Split series commit "[MOS] Reserve Imag32 quads that overlap reserved pairs" (733b59e025ee; gated as b880f5dd2105, same tree f4ea09e9146e): MOSRegisterInfo::getReservedRegs reserves every Imag32 quad whose sublo16 or subhi16 pair is reserved.
resolution.causal_explanation: With the quad over RS0 unreserved, RS0's register units were not reserved, so live-range computation for those units met a use of $rs0 without a def. Reserving the quad restores unit-level reservation of the stack pointer, scavenger slot and frame pointer bytes.
resolution.trigger_check: The unchanged variadic-call.ll runs through the fix commit's llc with the baseline configuration and exits 0; the same holds for the original vaprintf IR and for mos6502, and the upstream-only pair (u594 fails, u594-resv passes) isolates the rule as the cause.
